England Defeats Pakistan by 194 Runs to Clinch Test Series

England secured a 194-run victory over Pakistan in the second Test at Lord's, winning the series 2-0. England's pace bowlers were instrumental in the win, dismissing Pakistan for 110 in their second innings. The victory places England closer to India in the World Test Championship points table. Joe Root urged his team to remain focused after the win.
